They helped me several times with unexpected incidents and issues with my puppy. I had another vet initially, but once I brought Charlie here I never looked back! They staff is great and the prices are very reasonable.
Doctor Morales and Team are the BEST!!!

We recently took our kitty Lincy to the vet for her very first visit, and we couldn’t have asked for a better experience. From the moment we arrived, the entire staff was amazing, caring, and welcoming.

They took the time to answer all of our questions and made sure we felt comfortable and informed throughout the visit. It was clear that they genuinely care about the animals and the families they serve.

The clinic was also very clean, organized, and welcoming. We are extremely happy with the care Lincy received and will definitely be recommending this clinic to our family and friends.

Thank you to the entire team for making Lincy’s first vet visit such a positive experience! 🐱❤️

The best vet clinic ever!!!!! Excellent service! The receptionists are very friendly, the place is very clean, the facilities are great, and Dr. Morales is excellent! Very professional, accurate, concise, diligent, and clear with his diagnoses and explanations. I am very grateful for all the good work you have done for Max and Melisa. Thank you! 🐶🐶

Loved the environment, cleanliness & most importantly Dr. Silva & Samantha! They both took their time to explain everything to me & were very patient & kind with my dog who wasn’t being very nice himself. Very grateful, Remi will definitely be a patient of theirs for a long time!

I recommend Miami Lakes Veterinary  for your 4 leg babies. Dr. Morales is great, he helped our 4 year old Cockapoo. Benny boy  required a paw wound repair that needed stitches. We are happy 😊 to have found this location. …
Cleanest clinic,  remarkable staff.
They're the best.

I wouldn't want any other place other than Miami Lakes Veterinary Clinic. They have treated all my dogs for many years and always have the utmost care, love and compassion with the animals. They are very friendly, loving and truly care for your pet.
I, 100% recommend Miami Lakes Veterinary Clinic.
Dr Silva and the staff we extremely friendly! This is the first vet visit that our dog Toby is calm. I am so happy we came here!

First time client and I was impressed with the care and attention from both Samantha and Dr. Morales. Samantha was very good about explaining to my kids, what they were doing to our dog and even brought out some dog tattoos for the kids to remember the visit.

Miami Lakes Veterinary Clinic is excellent. The staff is very caring, professional. I usually get greeted by 'Katie' who's very thorough, professional and gives my Pixy a warm hello.
Dr Morales is wonderful. So knowledgeable, friendly, caring and doesn't waste time taking care of the problem. I've taken my Pixy there for her almost three years. All her vaccines, emergencies, advice have resulted in excellent avenues.
Just met 'Roxy' Vet's Assistant on a recent emergency visit.
She was so thorough and fantastic that I thought she was a new Vet there. I've recommended friends and can't say enough great things about them. All very, very nice.

Samantha was amazing during our urgent visit. She quickly got my dog comfortable, prepped everything for the doctor, and was so kind and compassionate throughout the entire process. Her calm, caring attitude made a stressful situation so much easier.
Amazing service and professionalism. Highly reccomend this vetinarian office.

My dog Macho gets very nervous,  like any dog does but they sit with him until he calms down, they give him his favorite peanut butter and they can proceed.  I’m very happy to have these veterinarians and their staff help me keep my boy healthy.
Thanks, Jose, for trusting us with your pet's care! ❤️
samantha was so kind and patient with us she made sure my dog was calm and safe she was amazing 10/10 service would be making another appointment here

I’m Always the happiest bringing my Chuck. The staff and Dr Silva have the most patience with his skittish butt. Lisandra, Samantha took care of him today and he even got his nails trimmed.
Thank you Miami Lakes Veterinary Clinic for taking such great care of us.
